test_title: PYST 8: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 30 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Suchitra will have / to wait another month / before she received / any reply to her letter.
solution:
The erroneous segment is "**before she received**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the usage of the **past tense** of the verb '**receive**' which is "**received**" is** grammatically incorrect.**
 
• In the given sentence, the **subject pronoun "she"** should be followed by the **conjugation **of the verb "receive" which is "**receives**".
 
• The given sentence is in the **future tense**.

**The correct sentence is**: *Suchitra will have to wait another month before she **receives **__any reply to her letter.*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**
